summary: The SiteDocument and related files provide a data structure and UI components for handling site-related documents, employment applications, and supporting site/discipline-based filtering within an administrative web system.
purpose: To facilitate the administration and management of site documents and employment applications, supporting user selection and validation workflows for staff admins.

workflows.name: Employment Applications Filtering and Display
steps: Site and Discipline dropdowns are populated via the user's session and agency context.
User sets filters for Site, Discipline, and date range (start/end date fields).
Validation occurs on filter input (required fields, regex for date, start date <= end date).
User can refresh the view to rebind data.
System retrieves and displays employment applications according to selected filters.
Applications are displayed with name, program, site, submission date, status, withdrawn date, and support links.
User can interact (view details, send email) for each application.
Errors and warnings are surfaced via dedicated panels.

workflows.name: ServiceCode Retrieval
steps: System or user triggers retrieval of all service codes or those filtered by course or timetable.
Service codes are returned, supporting localization (main and alt language).

workflows.name: Site Profile History Retrieval
steps: System retrieves historical actions (screen section, user, phone, etc.) for a given site.
Entries formatted with date, user/agency info, and contact.

workflows.name: EmailPopupDocument Search and Deletion
steps: System parses string input to retrieve email popup document entries (filename and path).
On delete request by ID, system deletes the associated file and directory.

business_rules: Filtering requires selection of a site and discipline, with logical defaults (ALL).
Start date and end date are required and validated for correct format.
Start date cannot be after end date.
Applications may be filtered to include withdrawn applications based on user checkbox.
Grid displays support pagination (default page size 50).
Employment application links must be hashed for security before navigation.
Email display depends on the presence of email data (no icon if missing).
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for start and end date fields.
CustomValidator ensures start date is not after end date.
calculations: ActionDateFormatted and AgencyUserDetailsFormatted use helper methods for display.
AgencyUserDetails includes logic for formatting based on user/admin context.
conditions: If SiteID is present in the query string, it's used as default; otherwise, current agency's sites are listed.
If no email, display no-icon for email links.
If user is HSPnet_Support_Team or SysAdmin, additional label formatting occurs for audit trail.
system_behavior: Dropdowns dynamically populate from data layer.
Auto-postback on dropdown selection changes triggers data refresh.
Client-side and server-side scripts are registered for page interaction.
Error and warning panels are always visible with AJAX controls.
dependencies: Resource localization for labels and messages.
AJAX Control Toolkit for UI behaviors.
exceptions: If validation fails, error/warning is displayed and no data query is performed.
If file deletion fails during EmailPopupDocument delete, catch block prevents unhandled errors.
content_gaps: Details on error handling strategies are limited.
Low-level implementation of data retrieval and persistence is abstracted.
Some referenced resources (e.g., external JS, localized text) are not present in the analyzed content.
